Name: Events Editor
Author: darthalex2014
Description:
[size=4][b]Also: [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29569][b]Better Events Core[/b][/url][/size]
Tool to assist with the development of Events.
Edit the Event Script in the config file, then press F6 (can be rebound) to start the event in the current Location.

I liked [b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71235188]91BlaDe[/url][/size][/b]'s [b][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11178]EventTester[/url][/size][/b], but it was outdated and threw errors in the console. So, I created my own from scratch.

You can specify as many events as you want in the [b][u]config.json[/u][/b] file, and then trigger them in-game!
You can also edit [b][u]config.json[/u][/b] while the game is running and trigger the modified event without needing to restart the game!

[b][size=3]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71235188]91BlaDe[/url] and his [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11178]EventTester[/url] for the inspiration.
